name: stats-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker + D1 backend for swift-stats (wire schema v1)
//exports: The read/query layer, importable by a sibling Worker bound to the same D1 (README §11). This is TypeScript SOURCE, not a build artifact: the consumer bundles it with esbuild/wrangler exactly as this Worker does, so there is no compiled copy that can lag behind the source. Nothing is published to npm — `private` stays true and a consumer depends on this directory by `file:` path or a git subpath. `npm run build:types` emits .d.ts for a consumer that cannot read the .ts directly.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply stats --remote && wrangler deploy
